# Support

- **Documentation:** [doc.s3nd.sh](https://doc.s3nd.sh). Guides, use cases, every CLI command and
  the protocol, route by route.
- **Something does not work:** run `s3nd doctor` first. It performs every operation s3nd needs
  against the real bucket and says which one failed. Then
  [open a bug report](https://github.com/AbderrahmaneMouzoune/s3nd/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  with its output; it never prints a secret.
- **Something is missing:**
  [open a feature request](https://github.com/AbderrahmaneMouzoune/s3nd/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A security problem:** [report it privately](./SECURITY.md), not in an issue.
